paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise indicates or requires, all product names, trade names, trademarks, service marks or logos used in this 2025 Annual Report are part of our intellectual property, although the "®" and "TM" trademark designations may have been omitted. For financial and other information about our segments and the geographic areas in which we do business, see "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7, "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" in Part II, Item 8, as well as Note 1, "Background and Basis of Presentation" and Note 22, "Segment Information" to our audited Consolidated Financial Statements, all included in this 2025 Annual Report.

Element Solutions, incorporated in Delaware in January 2014, is a leading global specialty chemicals technology company whose businesses supply a broad range of solutions that enhance the performance of products people use every day. Developed in multi-step technological processes, these innovative solutions enable customers' manufacturing processes in multiple high-value industries, including consumer electronics, power electronics, semiconductor fabrication, high-performance computing, communications and data storage infrastructure, automotive systems, industrial surface finishing and offshore energy. Our product innovation and product extensions are expected to continue to drive sales growth in both new and existing markets while expanding margins through a consistent focus on increasing customer value propositions.

We believe the majority of our businesses hold strong positions in the high-growth markets we serve. Our extensive global teams of specially trained scientists and engineers develop our solutions, and our expert sales and service organizations ensure our customers' needs are met every day. Our customer-centric innovation means we develop technologies to meet the already-identified needs of our current supply chains. We solve our customers' existing and emerging problems through technical service and innovation. We believe that our customers place significant value on the consistency and quality of our brands, on which we capitalize through significant market share, customer loyalty and supply chain access. In addition, operational risks and switching costs make it difficult for our customers to change suppliers which allows us to retain customers and maintain our market positions.

Our customers rely on our innovation to develop new products of their own, so our capabilities help them keep up in fast-paced, high-growth markets. To that end, we draw upon our broad and longstanding intellectual property portfolio and technical expertise, while working closely with both customers and OEMs on an ongoing basis, to develop proprietary solutions tailored to their manufacturing needs. We leverage these close relationships to win qualifications and specifications into their supply chains as well as to identify opportunities for new products; all of which provide potential additional revenue streams.

Our strategy is based on a balance of operational excellence and prudent capital allocation. Our operating teams focus on the strong execution of customer-led product development, superior technical sales support and continuous supply chain optimization. Our senior leadership aims to foster an environment of accountability and success for our operating teams while also evaluating and executing on high-return capital allocation opportunities that can drive compounding of long-term intrinsic value per share.

We regularly pursue targeted and opportunistic acquisitions in our existing and adjacent end-markets that seek to strengthen our current businesses, expand and diversify our product offerings, and enhance our growth and strategic position as well as divestitures to maximize long-term value creation for our shareholders.

MGS Transaction - On February 28, 2025, we completed the sale of our flexographic printing plate business, MacDermid Graphics Solutions, for $320 million, net of disposed cash. MacDermid Graphics Solutions was reported within the Specialties segment. The sale resulted in a gain of $66.5 million.

EFC Acquisition - On January 2, 2026, we completed the acquisition of EFC Gases & Advanced Materials, a provider of high-purity specialty gases and other advanced materials, for a purchase price of approximately $369 million, net of cash and subject to adjustments, with a potential earn-out based on EFC's 2026 performance of up to $30.0 million cash or 1.16 million Company shares.

Micromax Acquisition - On February 2, 2026, we completed the acquisition of Micromax, a global supplier of advanced electronics inks and pastes, for a purchase price of approximately $500 million, net of cash and subject to adjustments.

Our operations are organized into two reportable segments which were renamed in the fourth quarter of 2025: Electronics (MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions, previously known as Electronics) and Specialties (Element Specialties, previously known as Industrial & Specialty). In 2025, we achieved sales of $2.55 billion, to which our Electronics and Specialties segments contributed approximately 70% and 30%, respectively. Other than the names, there were no changes to the composition of the businesses that make up each segment in the fourth quarter of 2025. However, EFC will be reported in the Specialties segment and Micromax will be reported in the Electronics segment beginning in the first quarter of 2026.

Our segments share a common focus on attractive niches, which we believe will grow faster than their diverse, overall end-markets. Both segments provide products that, in substantially all cases, are consumed by customers as part of their production process, providing us with reliable and recurring revenue as products are replenished in order to continue production. We provide highly-technical service and support to customers and OEMs in order to support and optimize their manufacturing processes. While they typically represent only a small portion of our customers' costs, our products, along with our high-value added technical support, are seen as integral to customer product performance.
Neither of our segments is subject to significant seasonality. Electronics

Our Electronics segment researches, formulates and sells specialty chemicals and material process technologies for all types of electronics hardware, from complex printed circuit board designs to advanced semiconductor packaging. In high-performance datacenters, mobile communications, computers, automobiles and aerospace equipment, its products are an integral part of the electronics manufacturing process and the functionality of end-products. paragraphs: The following discussion of "risk factors" identifies the material factors that may have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations. Potential investors should carefully consider these risks and the other information in this 2025 Annual Report when evaluating our business. This discussion is not all inclusive and additional risks that are currently unknown to us or that we currently consider to be immaterial may also impair our business operations and cause our future results to differ from our expectations.

We may be unable to compete successfully in the competitive markets in which we operate. In these markets, we encounter competition from numerous and varied competitors in all areas of our businesses. Some of our competitors have longer operating histories, greater resources, greater brand recognition and a larger base of customers than we do. As a result, we may lose business, customers and market shares if we are unable to devote greater resources to the research and development, manufacturing, formulation, promotion, sale or support of our products, withstand adverse changes in economic conditions or prices of raw materials, and/or maintain competitive pricing. In addition, our competitors could enter into exclusive arrangements with our existing or potential customers or suppliers; each of which could limit our ability to generate sales, acquire necessary raw materials and/or significantly increase costs.

In addition, the markets in which we operate are driven by consumer preferences that are rapidly changing as well as frequent new product introductions and improvements. As a result, we must develop new products and services that offer distinct value to our customers in order to compete successfully. We seek to provide products tailored to the often-unique needs of our customers which require an ongoing level of innovation. Our inability to anticipate customers' changing needs or adapt to emerging technological and business trends accurately, control research and development costs or execute our innovation strategy could adversely affect our ability to sustain our market positions and/or penetrate new markets.

Consolidation of our competitors could also place us at a competitive disadvantage and reduce our profitability. We operate in industries which are fragmented on a global scale, but in which there has been a trend toward consolidation in recent years. Consolidations of our competitors may jeopardize the strength of our positions in one or more of our markets which could adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations as well as our growth potential.

Our go-to-market strategy is focused on leveraging our existing portfolio of products and services as well as introducing new products and services to meet the demands of our customers in a continually changing technological landscape. To successfully execute this strategy, we must gauge the direction of the commercial and technological progress in our key end-markets, emphasize the aspects of our core business where demand remains strong, identify and capitalize on organic growth, and innovate by developing new products in such changing markets and services that will enable us to expand beyond our existing technology categories. Any failure to successfully execute this strategy, including any failure to invest sufficiently in strategic growth areas and support our research and development activities, could adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.

In addition, the process of developing new high-technology products or enhancing existing products is complex, costly and uncertain. After we develop a product, we must be able to manufacture appropriate volumes quickly while managing costs and maintaining the high-quality level that our customers expect. Any delay in the development, forecast, production and/or marketing of a new product could result in us not being among the first to market which could further harm our competitive position.

Element Solutions, incorporated in Delaware in January 2014, is a leading global specialty chemicals technology company whose businesses supply a broad range of solutions that enhance the performance of products people use every day. Developed in multi-step technological processes, these innovative solutions enable customers' manufacturing processes in multiple high-value industries, including consumer electronics, power electronics, semiconductor fabrication, high-performance computing, communications and data storage infrastructure, automotive systems, industrial surface finishing and offshore energy. Our product innovation and product extensions are expected to continue to drive sales growth in both new and existing markets while expanding margins through a consistent focus on increasing customer value propositions.

Our operations are organized into two segments: Electronics and Specialties. In 2025, we achieved net sales of $2.55 billion, to which our Electronics and Specialties segments contributed approximately 70% and 30%, respectively.

Electronics – The Electronics segment researches, formulates and sells specialty chemicals and material process technologies for all types of electronics hardware from complex printed circuit board designs to advanced semiconductor packaging. In high-performance datacenters, mobile communications, computers, automobiles and aerospace equipment, its products are an integral part of the electronics manufacturing process and the functionality of end-products. The segment's "wet chemistries" for metallization, surface treatments and solderable finishes form the physical circuitry pathways and its "assembly materials," such as SMT, pastes, fluxes and adhesives, join those pathways together. The segment provides solutions through the following businesses: Assembly Solutions, Circuitry Solutions and Semiconductor Solutions.

Specialties – The Specialties segment researches, formulates and sells specialty chemicals and material process technologies that enhance surfaces or improve industrial processes in diverse industrial sectors from automotive trim to transcontinental infrastructure to high-design faucets. Its products include chemical systems that protect and decorate metal and plastic surfaces and chemistries used in water-based hydraulic control fluids for offshore energy production. The segment's products are used in the aerospace, automotive, construction, consumer electronics and oil and gas production end-markets. The segment provides solutions through the following businesses: Industrial Solutions and Energy Solutions. MacDermid Graphics Solutions was reported within the Specialties segment. The sale resulted in a gain of $66.5 million.

•EFC Acquisition - On January 2, 2026, we completed the acquisition of EFC Gases & Advanced Materials, a provider of high-purity specialty gases and other advanced materials, for a purchase price of approximately $369 million, net of cash and subject to adjustments, with a potential earn-out based on EFC's 2026 performance of up to $30.0 million cash or 1.16 million Company shares.

•Add-on Term Loans & Revolver Upsize - On February 2, 2026, we completed the syndication of $450 million of Add-on Term Loans and a 5-year $500 million senior secured revolving credit facility, which replaced our then existing $375 million revolving facility, upsizing the facility by $125 million and extending its maturity to 2031. The proceeds of the Add-on Term Loans were used to fund a portion of the purchase price of the Micromax Acquisition.
•Cash Dividends - During the year ended December 31, 2025, approximately $77.8 million was returned to our stockholders in the form of cash dividends.

•Repurchases of Common Stock - During the year ended December 31, 2025, we repurchased 1.2 million shares of our common stock for $25.0 million. The remaining authorization under our stock repurchase program was approximately $556 million at December 31, 2025.

We regularly pursue targeted and opportunistic acquisitions in our existing or adjacent end-markets that seek to strengthen our current businesses, expand and diversify our product offerings, and enhance our growth and strategic position. We expect to achieve commercial and distribution efficiencies by expanding into related categories that can be marketed through our existing distribution channels or provide us with new distribution channels for our existing products. To the extent we pursue future acquisitions, we expect that acquisition candidates would demonstrate a combination of attractive margins, strong cash flow characteristics, niche leading positions and consumable products that generate recurring revenue. We believe the diversity of the niche end-markets we serve will enable us to continue our growth and maintain strong cash flow generation throughout economic cycles and mitigate the impact of a downturn in any single market. We will only pursue an acquisition candidate when it is deemed to be fiscally prudent and meets our acquisition criteria. We anticipate that any future acquisitions would be financed through a combination of cash on hand, availability under our Credit Agreement and/or new debt or equity offerings.

In 2025, approximately 79% of our net sales originated outside of the U.S. and were denominated in numerous currencies, including the Chinese yuan and euro. Therefore, fluctuations in foreign exchange rates in any given reporting period may positively or negatively impact our financial performance. Foreign exchange translation had an immaterial impact on our 2025 net sales performance.

In addition, our foreign subsidiaries are subject to foreign currency risk relating to receipts from customers, payments to suppliers and intercompany transactions that are not in their functional currency, which is typically their local currency. As a result, our foreign subsidiaries may enter, and have entered, into foreign exchange hedges designed to protect against transaction exposures. We actively assess our hedging programs in order to mitigate foreign exchange risk exposures. This includes programs to hedge our foreign currency denominated balance sheet exposures as well as foreign currency anticipated cash flows.

Element Solutions於2014年1月在特拉華州註冊成立，為全球領先之專業化化學品科技公司，其業務提供廣泛之解決方案，用以提升人們日常使用之產品性能。這些創新解決方案經多階段技術製程開發而成，可協助客戶在多個高價值產業之製造流程中提升效能，包括消費電子、功率電子、半導體製造、高性能計算、通訊與資料儲存基礎建設、汽車系統、工業表面處理及離岸能源。我們之產品創新與產品延伸預期將持續推動新舊市場之銷售成長，並透過持續聚焦於提升客戶價值主張來擴大毛利率。

我們相信，我們絕大多數業務在所服務之高成長市場中擁有強勢地位。我們廣泛之全球團隊由特別訓練之科學家與工程師組成，開發我們之解決方案，而我們之專業銷售與服務團隊則確保客戶之需求每日皆能被滿足。我們以客戶為中心之創新意味著我們開發技術以符合現有供應鏈已識別之需求。我們透過技術服務與創新解決客戶之現有與未來問題。我們相信，客戶對我們品牌之一致性與品質給予高度價值，我們透過龐大市佔率、客戶忠誠度與供應鏈接觸來加以發揮。
我們之客戶依賴我們之創新來開發他們自己的新產品，因此我們之能力協助他們在快速成長之市場中保持競爭力。為此，我們運用我們廣泛且長期之智慧財產權組合與技術專業知識，同時與客戶與OEM持續合作，以開發符合其製造需求之專利解決方案。我們運用這些緊密關係以取得其供應鏈之認證與規格，並識別新產品之機會；所有這些皆提供潛在之額外收入來源。
我們之策略基於運營卓越與謹慎資本配置之間的平衡。我們之運營團隊專注於客戶主導之產品開發之強勢執行、優越之技術銷售支援與持續之供應鏈優化。我們之高階領導階層旨在營造一個責任與成功之環境，以支持運營團隊，同時評估與執行高回報之資本配置機會，以推動每股長期內在價值之複利成長。
我們定期在現有與鄰近之終端市場尋求目標性與機會性之收購，以強化現有業務、擴展與多元化產品組合，並提升成長與戰略地位，同時進行資產處置以最大化對股東之長期價值創造。
MGS交易 - 於2025年2月28日，我們完成出售我們之柔性印刷版業務MacDermid Graphics Solutions，交易金額為3.2億美元，扣除已處置現金後之淨額。MacDerm, Graphics Solutions於財務報表中歸屬於特殊產品分部。此交易產生收益6,650萬美元。
EFC收購 - 於2026年1月2日，我們完成收購EFC Gases & Advanced Materials，該公司為高純度專業氣體及其他先進材料之供應商，交易金額約為3.69億美元，扣除現金後並根據調整，並可能根據EFC於2026年之表現，以最高3,000萬美元現金或116萬本公司股票作為追加付款。
Micromax 收購 - 2026 年 2 月 2 日，本公司完成對 Micromax 的收購，Micromax 是一家全球性進階電子墨水與糊劑供應商，收購價格約為 5 億美元，扣除現金後，並根據調整後的金額計算。

本公司業務分為兩個應報告分部，於 2025 年第四季更名為：電子產品（MacDermid Alpha Electronics Solutions，先前稱為電子產品）與專業產品（Element Specialties，先前稱為工業與專業產品）。2025 年，本公司實現銷售額為 25.5 億美元，其中電子產品與專業產品分部分別貢獻約 70% 與 30%。除了名稱外，2025 年第四季組成各分部的業務內容均無變動。然而，自 2026 年第一季起，EFC 將歸入專業產品分部，Micromax 則歸入電子產品分部。

本公司各分部均聚焦於具吸引力的專業領域，本公司認為這些領域的成長速度將快於其多樣化的整體終端市場。各分部提供的產品，基本上皆為客戶在生產過程中所使用，使本公司能獲得穩定且持續的收入，因產品需不斷補充以維持生產。本公司為客戶與原廠（OEM）提供高度技術性的服務與支援，以協助並優化其製造流程。雖然本公司產品通常僅佔客戶成本的一小部分，但本公司產品搭配高價值的技術支援，被視為客戶產品性能的重要組成部分。
本公司各分部均不受顯著季節性影響。電子產品
本公司電子產品分部研究、製造並銷售用於所有類型電子硬體的專業化化學品與製程技術，從複雜的印刷電路板設計到先進的半導體封裝。在高性能資料中心、行動通訊、電腦、汽車與航空設備中，其產品為電子製造流程與終端產品功能的重要組成部分。該分部的 "濕化學品" 用於金屬化、表面處理與可焊性塗層，形成物理電路路徑，其 "組裝材料"，例如表面黏著技術（SMT）、糊劑、助焊劑與黏合劑，則將這些路徑連接在一起。

paragraphs: 本「管理層討論與分析」部分應與本年度2025年財務報告第二部分第8項所載之「財務報表與補充資料」以及本年度2025年財務報告其他部分所載之經審計合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。『概要』與『2025年重點』簡要說明本公司業務與本部分或其他部分所提及之某些重大事件。為完整了解本公司業務與這些事件之討論，應完整閱讀本年度2025年財務報告。

Element Solutions於2014年1月在特拉華州註冊成立，為全球領先之專業化學品科技公司，其業務提供廣泛之解決方案，用以提升人們日常使用之產品之性能。這些創新解決方案為多階段技術製程所開發，使客戶在多個高價值產業之製造流程中受益，包括消費電子、功率電子、半導體製造、高性能計算、通訊與資料儲存基礎建設、汽車系統、工業表面處理與離岸能源。本公司之產品創新與產品延伸預期將持續推動新舊市場之銷售成長，並透過持續著重於提升客戶價值主張，來擴大邊際利益。
本公司之營運分為兩個應報告分部：電子與特殊性。2025年，本公司實現淨銷售額為25.5億美元，其中電子與特殊性分部分別貢獻約70%與30%。

電子 – 電子分部從事研發、製造與銷售用於所有類型電子硬體之專業化學品與材料製程技術，從複雜之印刷電路板設計至先進之半導體封裝。在高性能資料中心、行動通訊、電腦、汽車與航空設備中，其產品為電子製造流程與終端產品功能之重要組成部分。該分部之「濕化學」用以進行金屬化、表面處理與可焊性表面處理，形成物理電路路徑，其「組裝材料」，如SMT、焊膏、助焊劑與黏合劑，則將這些路徑連接在一起。該分部透過以下業務提供解決方案：組裝解決方案、電路解決方案與半導體解決方案。

特殊性 – 特殊性分部從事研發、製造與銷售用以增強表面或改善工業製程之專業化學品與材料製程技術，應用於多樣工業領域，從汽車內裝至跨大陸基礎建設至高設計水龍頭。其產品包括保護與裝飾金屬與塑膠表面之化學系統，以及用於離岸能源生產之水基液壓控制流體之化學品。該分部之產品應用於航空、汽車、建築、消費電子與油氣生產終端市場。該分部透過以下業務提供解決方案：工業解決方案與能源解決方案。於2025年2月28日，本公司完成出售我們之柔性印刷版業務MacDermid Graphics Solutions。
• 投資組合優化 – 於2025年2月28日，本公司完成出售我們之柔性印刷版業務MacDermid Graphics Solutions，交易金額約為3.2億美元，扣除已處分現金後之淨額。MacDermid Graphics Solutions於財務報表中歸屬於特殊性分部。此次出售產生收益約為6,650萬美元。
• EFC收購 – 於2026年1月2日，本公司完成收購EFC Gases & Advanced Materials，一家提供高純度專業氣體及其他先進材料之供應商，交易金額約為3.69億美元，扣除現金後，並受調整條款約束，並可能根據EFC於2026年之表現，以最多3,000萬美元現金或116萬本公司股票作為追加付款。
• Micromax收購 – 於2026年2月2日，本公司完成收購Micromax，一家全球供應先進電子油墨與焊膏之供應商，交易金額約為5億美元，扣除現金後，並受調整條款約束。

•Add-on Term Loans & Revolver Upsize - 2026年2月2日，本公司完成4.5億美元Add-on Term Loans及5年期5億美元的高階擔保循環信貸設施 syndication，取代當時的3.75億美元循環信貸設施，將信貸設施規模擴充1.25億美元，並將到期日延長至2031年。Add-on Term Loans所得資金用以支應Micromax收購部分購併價格。
•Cash Dividends - 2025年度結算期間，本公司以現金股息形式向股東回饋約7,780萬美元。
•Repurchases of Common Stock - 2025年度結算期間，本公司以2,500萬美元購回120萬股普通股。截至2025年12月31日，本公司股票購回計畫尚餘授權金額約55.6億美元。

本公司定期尋求在現有或相鄰終端市場進行目標性及機會性收購，以強化現有業務、擴展及多元化產品組合，並提升成長與戰略地位。本公司預期透過擴展至可透過現有通路行銷或提供新通路的相關類別，實現商業與通路效率。若未來進行收購，預期收購對象將具備吸引人的毛利率、強勁現金流特性、專業領域領導地位及可產生持續收入的消耗性產品。本公司相信，所服務的多元專業終端市場將有助於持續成長，並在經濟週期中維持強勁現金流產生，同時降低單一市場衰退的影響。本公司僅在認為財務上謹慎且符合收購標準時，才會進行收購對象的評估。預期未來收購將透過現金、信貸協議下可用額度及/或新債務或股權發行進行資金籌措。
2025年，約79%的淨銷售額來自美國境外，並以多種貨幣計價，包括人民幣及歐元。因此，任何會計期間外匯匯率的波動可能對財務表現產生正面或負面影響。外匯換算對2025年淨銷售額表現影響不顯著。
此外，本公司境外子公司面臨與客戶收款、供應商付款及非功能貨幣的內部交易相關的外幣風險，其功能貨幣通常是當地貨幣。因此，本公司境外子公司可能進行，且已進行，外匯對沖交易以保護交易風險。本公司積極評估對沖計畫以降低外匯風險。這包括對沖外幣計價資產負債及預期外幣現金流的計畫。

headings: 我們可能無法在所從事的競爭市場中成功競爭，因此可能面臨價格壓力、較少的客戶訂單、邊際率下降及市場佔有率流失。
若我們未能成功執行我們的市場推廣策略，將可能影響我們的業務及財務表現。
我們龐大的國際業務使我們面臨在海外國家從事業務的風險，這些風險可能影響我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果。
未能吸引並留住關鍵人才，包括我們的高階管理人員，或有效管理繼任計畫，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生不利影響。
我們對某些關鍵客戶、合同製造商、供應商及經銷商的依賴，可能對我們整體銷售及獲利能力產生不利影響。
我們可能無法實現併購或資產處置預期的效益，這可能對我們現有業務、聲譽及財務狀況產生不利影響。
產業與消費者趨勢可能導致我們營運成果出現顯著波動，並對我們的財務狀況產生重大不利影響。
原材料供應與價格及其他成本的波動，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生負面影響。
若我們無法保護我們的智慧財產權，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成不利影響。
本公司有效稅率、稅務費用及稅務負債的變動，可能對財務狀況、營運成果及流動性造成不利影響。
化學製造 inherently 具有危險性，可能導致事故，進而幹擾本公司營運或造成重大損失或負債。
本公司 offshore 油產業產品受 offshore 油生產及鑽探產業內在危險性影響，可能因這些危險性而導致本公司承受重大負債或損失。
部分產品可能受各種出口管制法規影響，出口可能需要美國國務院或美國商務部許可。
未能遵守反貪腐法規，可能使本公司遭受處罰並損害本公司聲譽。
未能遵守國際貿易限制及經濟制裁法律法規，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生不利影響。
數據隱私及數據保護法律法規的變更，或未能遵守相關法律法規，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司淨銷售額及毛利率會根據產品、客戶及地理組成而有所不同，使得預測未來營運成果變得困難。
不利的貨幣兌換率波動可能對本公司營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司信貸協議及其他債務協議包含限制條款，可能限制本公司營運業務的靈活性。
本公司及其子公司未來可能產生重大額外債務，這將導致對本公司業務的額外限制，並影響財務狀況。
未來若發生本公司有形或無形長壽命資產減損，可能對營運成果產生重大影響。
重大網路安全相關事件可能對本公司營運造成重大幹擾，並損害本公司聲譽及營運成果。
企業社會責任，特別是與環境、社會及治理（ESG）事項相關者，可能導致額外成本並使本公司面臨新風險。
本公司股票價格的波動可能對本公司及其股東造成不利影響。
未來發行或出售本公司普通股或優先股可能壓低本公司普通股的價格。
本公司無法保證將持續宣佈發放紅利。
paragraphs: 下列有關「風險因素」的討論識別出可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生重大不利影響的重要因素。潛在投資人應仔細考慮這些風險及其他本2025年年度報告中的資訊，以評估本公司業務。此討論並非完整列出，目前未知或本公司認為目前不重要的其他風險也可能影響本公司業務運作，並導致未來結果與本公司預期有所差異。

本公司可能無法在所從事的競爭市場中成功競爭。在這些市場中，我們在業務各個領域都面臨來自眾多且多樣競爭對手的競爭。部分競爭對手擁有較長的營運歷史、較多的資源、較高的品牌認知度以及較大的客戶基礎。因此，若本公司無法投入更多資源於研究與發展、製造、配方、推廣、銷售或支援我們的產品，無法抵禦經濟條件或原材料價格的不利變動，或無法維持具有競爭力的價格，我們可能會失去業務、客戶及市場佔有率。此外，競爭對手可能與我們現有或潛在的客戶或供應商簽訂獨佔協議，這可能會限制我們產生銷售、取得必要原材料及/或顯著提高成本的能力。
此外，我們所從事的市場受消費者偏好的快速變動以及頻繁的新產品推出與改進所驅動。因此，我們必須開發能為客戶提供獨特價值的新產品與服務，以成功競爭。我們致力於提供符合客戶經常獨特需求的產品，這需要持續的創新。若我們無法準確預測客戶需求的變動或適應興起的科技與商業趨勢，控制研究與發展成本，或執行創新策略，可能會對我們維持市場地位及/或進入新市場的能力產生不利影響。
我們競爭對手的併購也可能使我們處於競爭劣勢，並降低我們的利潤。我們所從事的產業在全球範圍內屬於分散型產業，但近年來出現了趨向併購的趨勢。競爭對手的併購可能威脅我們在一個或多個市場中的地位，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運結果以及成長潛力產生不利影響。

我們的市場進入策略聚焦於善用現有產品與服務組合，並推出新產品與服務以符合客戶在不斷變化的科技環境中的需求。為成功執行此策略，我們必須評估關鍵終端市場的商業與科技進展方向，強調我們核心業務中需求持續強勁的部分，識別並把握內生成長機會，並透過在這些變動市場中開發新產品與服務來創新，使我們能拓展至現有科技類別之外。若未能成功執行此策略，包括未能足夠投資於戰略成長領域及支援研究與發展活動，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生不利影響。
此外，開發新高技術產品或提升現有產品的過程複雜、成本高昂且不確定。在開發出產品後，我們必須能快速製造適當數量，同時控制成本並維持客戶所期待的高品質水平。若新產品的開發、預測、生產及/或行銷出現延遲，可能會導致我們無法成為首發上市的企業，這可能會進一步損害我們的競爭地位。
